verdicts.factCheck: The exchange endpoint page fetched today has sha256 812ecf7e87ec0470, and authorizeAqav2Role at line 1384 takes type, token and role only, so no address and no code check is published. The aligned quote assets page has sha256 9fd997fe977532e3; line 15 says the treasury deployer designates a treasury address, both deployers stake 500k HYPE, activation is by validator vote, and the linked HyperEVM contract rebalances with the treasury address. nanoreth tag nb-20261125-2 src/node/primitives/transaction.rs lines 49-57 and 77-96 return the sender of a system transaction from the s value with no signature check, which backs the difference. The transfers page lines 13-25 and 77 say credits are system transactions sent as the token system address and that nothing checks supply. My own eth_getTransactionCount on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm at head 0x31ee6af returns 0x1 and eth_getBalance returns 0x9d908ef23bc0864f, the values the finding reports. No source says HyperCore would accept the PoolManager as treasury address or would send a transaction in the treasury's name; that link stays unconfirmed, which is why the finding is plausible and not confirmed.
verdicts.codeCheck: sync stores balanceOfSelf at the time of the call (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288). _settle credits reservesNow minus reservesBefore only for the synced currency inside the same unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:349-365), so a balance lowered from outside any unlock is never debited from any delta, pool reserve or ERC-6909 total. take and burn paths then end in Currency.transfer, which reverts with ERC20TransferFailed when the token refuses a transfer above the balance (src/types/Currency.sol:55-86). The mechanism holds: the last holders in that currency could not withdraw.
verdicts.corrections: coreRefs cite src/types/Currency.sol:50-60; the ERC-20 transfer and its revert are at src/types/Currency.sol:55-86 (lines 50-53 are the native branch). The actor is right: operator, since the treasury deployer stake and a validator vote are needed and an ordinary account can supply neither.

clearedSpotChecks.note: tstore-rollback.json shows every case ok on all three endpoints. My own eth_call on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, with a DELEGATECALL into code that does TSTORE(0,7) and then REVERT, read 0 from TLOAD(0) afterwards, and 7 when the callee stops instead of reverting. CurrencyDelta, NonzeroDeltaCount and Lock therefore lose the writes of a reverted frame as on Ethereum.
